verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS operations-automation product like AFK, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a self-hosted deployment, downloadable server, or on-prem option. The bare 'GitHubCode' link text is not evidence that the core product can be self-hosted, and the other items describe hosted workspace features only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
